selectionRules.tieBreak: seed ascending, slot index ascending, then component ID ascending unless case criterion ranks first
selectionRules.maximumIndependentSetExample: lexicographically first exact maximum independent set in option-ID order; diagnostic only
selectionRules.persistence: registered one-to-one adjacent-slot contestedTracks only; exact graph isomorphism disregards X node identities

cases.criterion: Largest contested clique by node count; then seed, slot, component ID ascending.
Largest contested component with alpha = 1; then seed, slot, component ID ascending.
Largest contested component with alpha = 2; then seed, slot, component ID ascending.
Highest alpha; then most nodes; then seed, slot, component ID ascending.
Lowest edge density; then most nodes; then seed, slot, component ID ascending.
A maximum independent set includes a {B,C} option and at least one other disjoint option; then largest alpha, most nodes, earliest.
Longest registered one-to-one contested track with a non-isomorphic adjacent graph; then seed and track ID ascending.
